# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

This project is a static web calculator with no server-side components.
Only the latest deployed version at <https://calcula-soldo.vercel.app> is supported.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you find a security vulnerability, please **do not** open a public GitHub issue.

Instead, open a GitHub issue with the label `security` and mark it as **confidential** using the
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability)
feature available in the Security tab of this repository.

We aim to respond within **7 days** and to resolve or publicly disclose within **90 days**.

This project does not offer a bug bounty program.
